note: header region -- renders: logo, app name, user settings expand, search box controls
app navigation sidebar -- renders: fixed navigation items (Files, Favorites, Shared with me, Shared with others, Shared links, System tags filter, Trashbin) and settings button
controls bar -- renders: view switcher, new file button, upload progress, file action panel; breadcrumb is subtracted as it renders user-created folder names
file table column headers -- renders: Name, Size, Modified column titles, sort controls, and select all checkbox
file selection checkboxes -- operator controls for selecting files
file list table cells -- renders: file size and date computed values; filename cells are subtracted as they contain user-generated file names
hidden upload field -- renders: upload start button control
